name: Phalangeal Fracture of the Hand
definition: Fracture of a proximal, middle or distal phalanx, with functional risk from rotation, joint involvement or tendon injury.

investigations.principle: Finger radiographs characterize fracture and joint involvement.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when soft-tissue, neural, marrow, occult injury, infection or other condition-specific questions require it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Intra-articular, rotated, unstable or open fractures require specialist care.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Anguli-bhagna principles may complement rehabilitation after modern stabilization.

patientEducation.summary: Fracture of a proximal, middle or distal phalanx, with functional risk from rotation, joint involvement or tendon injury.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
